title: Inception
tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the sub-conscious of his targets, is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: 'inception', the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets.

title: Interstellar
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

title: Pulp Fiction
tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean that you have character.
overview: A burger-loving hitman, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll, and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper.

title: Spirited Away
tagline: Nothing that happens is ever forgotten, even if you can't remember it.
overview: A young girl wandering into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, where humans are changed into beasts, must seek work in a colossal bathhouse to find a way to free herself and her parents.

title: Parasite
tagline: Act like you own the place.
overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

title: The Matrix
overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
tagline: More than one wears the mask.
overview: Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe, and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

title: Whiplash
overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.

title: Gladiator
tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
overview: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.
